ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Daycare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the scope and scale of daycare fraud in Minnesota, including the amount of money allegedly stolen and the number of individuals and organizations involved.
questions: How much money has been allegedly stolen through daycare fraud in Minnesota?
What are the most common schemes used to commit daycare fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale problem and hold those responsible accountable. By analyzing data and public records, we can gain a better understanding of the extent of the issue and identify potential solutions.
